title: UK Announces IRGC Proscription as Terrorist Organization
detail: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer confirmed legislation to formally proscribe Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as a terrorist organization would be introduced 'as quickly as possible,' citing documented links to terror plots on British soil, attacks on Jewish communities in the UK, and IRGC cyber warfare operations against British infrastructure. The move followed the EU's January 29, 2026 decision to proscribe the IRGC, placing significant pressure on the UK government to align. The UK proscription was expected to be announced in the King's Speech alongside broader 'proscription-like measures' targeting state-linked terrorist entities. Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned the anticipated move as a 'politically motivated' action serving Israeli interests.

media.caption: UK announces plans to proscribe Iran's IRGC as terror group

title: Islamic Republic Executes Four Young Men Convicted for 2022 Uprising
detail: Within a 48-hour period, Iran executed four young men convicted on charges related to participation in the 2022 'Woman, Life, Freedom' uprising. In addition to Mehrab Abdollahzadeh executed in Urmia, three others were executed in Mashhad — all accused of activities during the 2022 nationwide protests. The rapid-succession executions were condemned by Iran Human Rights (Oslo) and Amnesty International as part of a deliberate policy of deterrence through capital punishment. Seven female political prisoners at Evin Prison were simultaneously denied family visits for three weeks as punishment for participating in the 'No to Execution Tuesdays' campaign. Human rights advocates noted that 2026 was on track to be the deadliest year for executions in Iran in decades.

media.caption: Iran executes four young men convicted for 2022 protests
